message.content: In December, Los Angeles enjoys mild, comfortable weather. The average daily high is about **68 °F (20 °C)**, while the average low dips to roughly **48 °F (9 °C)**. If you’re looking at a single “average temperature” figure, it’s usually quoted around **58 °F (14 °C)** for the whole month. The city rarely sees temperatures below freezing or above 70 °F during this time.
